verdict: This is one connected, well-sourced story with a real turn (MA strikes down the paper, 120 signatures, resignation) and a sharp last line. The continuous world holds: the turn_12nov strip whips with speed lines from the DPR back past the MK barrier to the chair stage. Two moments are at the house bar: the stamp at 30 s (stamp_MA.png: scale-down, ghost, burst lines, kick) and the 732 seats lighting up as the counter rolls (slam_732.png, t054). The rest falls below it. Five headline swaps leave ghosted or clipped text in the 2 s stills (2, 8, 26, 28, 55 s). The barrier at MK never visibly lifts. Six runs of near-identical frames (16-18, 20-22, 30-34, 42-46, 50-52). The number the ending depends on, 96.214.691, is never shown crisp. Render debris appears on several frames: the pixel-noise table base, stray building slabs at the frame edges, a lone hand. The opening frame states the news clearly but has no motion and an empty lower third, and the last frame says 'Lo nggak termasuk' in both headline and caption, but the image reads as LO caged in orange blocks rather than shut out of the hall. Audio passes on the measured numbers only; nobody has listened to it. Average 7.0, with motion_craft, every_2s_new and readability at 6, below the gate's 7 floor. Not ready to ship.
